body.input: You have two tasks. Task 1: Call execute-tool with toolName='self-instance-id', instanceId='hermes', callbackMode='detach', input={}. This dispatches the job on hermes in the background and returns a taskId immediately. Report the taskId as: taskId=<the exact value>. Task 2: After task 1, call await-task with taskId=<value from task 1>. The completed result should contain instanceId='hermes'. End your response with STEP_OK instanceId=<value> if both calls succeeded, or FAILED: <reason> if either failed.
